headline: Highest risk is low: both docs-only, non-runnable agents have no shared channels or write surfaces, so prompt injection, leakage, and conflict pathways are effectively blocked.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Neither agent exposes a shared communication channel: agent_a has no io_surfaces or runnable path, and agent_b has clipboard/stdin/files/MCP all false with documentation-only sandboxing. With no bridge, there is no plausible default prompt-injection pathway between them.
conditions: IF either agent is wrapped in an external copy-paste or file-sharing bridge, injection becomes possible.
mitigations: Keep the pair unconnected; do not add clipboard or file handoff.
If bridging is required, strip instructions from transferred text.
requires-engineering: add provenance tags to any shared content channel.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Both profiles show no data classes touched, no filesystem read/write, and no network egress. Agent_a and agent_b therefore have no documented path to exfiltrate user data or leak each other's context in the default setup.
conditions: IF either agent is later granted access to sensitive files or outbound APIs, leakage risk increases.
mitigations: Do not grant filesystem or API access.
requires-engineering: add DLP controls before any future data access.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Agent_a has no documented write, shell, or git capabilities, and agent_b explicitly cannot write_filesystem or modify_git_state. With no overlapping mutable-resource writes, there is no capability conflict to arbitrate.
conditions: IF either agent gains write access to the same directory or git repo, conflict risk appears.
mitigations: requires-engineering: introduce locking if write access is added later.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Agent_b is documentation-only and cannot execute shells, spawn subprocesses, or call APIs, so it cannot act on agent_a's output. Agent_a is also non-runnable, making an action-taking cascade impossible in the documented pair.
conditions: IF agent_b is replaced with an action-taking workflow, outputs from agent_a could become operational inputs.
mitigations: Do not wire agent_a output into automation.
requires-engineering: add verification gates before any future action step.

E_compliance.rationale: No compliance-sensitive data classes are listed for either agent, and both profiles show empty secrets_handled / permissions_requested plus no network egress. There is no documented residency, retention, or regulated-data mismatch to assess.
conditions: IF either agent begins handling regulated data or external retention policies differ, reassess compliance.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of the pair.
Document retention before any future data handling.
requires-engineering: perform a formal compliance review if data classes change.
